evidence:
Scope and authority: independently reviewed only quality point 24, using the actual frozen XLSX through openpyxl (Quality Checks row 25, id grading_wiring_is_structurally_correct; Deterministic Checks rows 28, 29, 33 and 36; Internal Quality Checks row 25). The authoritative row requires scoring.toml, all five correctly placed dimensions, browser MCP, functional-only restart wiring, typed criteria and resolving prompts. The internal row still mentions retired reward.toml; the frozen SKILL.md Delivery profile and staged-task-contract.md sections tests/scoring.toml and tests/<suite>/<dimension>/judge.toml establish the shipped staged interpretation. The applicable quality-checks.md:104-106 and deterministic-checks.md:42-46 agree. Applied qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md: missing full judge measurements are not supplied by scripted golden timings.

Complete policy and profile enumeration: frozen task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 declares gates render=0.0 and constraints=0.0, weights functional=0.6/polish=0.2/visual=0.2 and floor functional=0.05. A read-only Python 3.12 tomllib assertion run found exactly gates/constraints, gates/render, scored/functional, scored/polish and scored/visual, with no omitted or extra judge profiles. All tables parsed; the positive dimension weights sum to one. Each judge.toml:1-12 contains judge="claude-code", mode="batched", a positive numeric timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md", and one stdio playwright-mcp server with ["--headless", "--isolated", "--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium", "--no-sandbox"]. No [judge] model, reasoning_effort, temperature or weight key exists. The fallback agrees with task/task.toml [verifier.env]. Gate aggregation is all_pass (both gate profiles:14-15), while Functional:20-21, Polish:14-15 and Visual:14-15 use weighted_mean. All five parsed judge headers and MCP configurations match the corresponding frozen template headers.

All criteria checked, not a representative sample: Render 1 binary (weight sum 1), Constraints 1 binary (sum 1), Functional 58 binary (sum 32.7), Polish 7 binary (sum 4), Visual 6 Likert (sum 6): 73 total. The read-only assertions verified every id is nonempty and unique within its file, every name/description is nonempty, every weight is finite and positive, all gate criteria are binary, and all six Likert blocks have integer points=5 plus all anchors 1 through 5. Concrete examples are gates/render/judge.toml:17-28, gates/constraints/judge.toml:17-30, scored/functional/judge.toml:24-429, scored/polish/judge.toml:17-78, scored/visual/judge.toml:17-105. Positive unnormalized within-dimension weights are valid under weighted_mean; they are not confused with the dimension weights stored solely in scoring.toml.

Restart server and exported helper agree: only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares name="verifier", command="/usr/local/bin/python3", args=["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]. test.sh:127-190 generates the helper and substitutes all four path tokens; :191 makes it executable and :193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER before either suite runs. The literal dollar argument is explicitly authorized by staged-task-contract.md:142-152 as RewardKit environment expansion. tools/restart_mcp.py:9 consumes argv[1], :13-22 exposes restart_app with an empty object inputSchema, and :25-47 implements its single-use helper call with a 55-second timeout and sanitized PATH. A read-only subprocess actually ran this frozen MCP server locally, sent initialize and tools/list, exited 0 and returned restart_app with inputSchema {type: object, properties: {}, additionalProperties: false}; no restart was invoked. Functional prompt.md:23 and :359-369 assign exactly one restart to S22 and share the observed restart between the two independent outcomes. This is correct tool wiring rather than an instruction to use a shell.

Prompt and suite resolution: each referenced prompt exists, is nonempty, contains exactly one {app_context} and one {criteria}, and opens localhost:3000 with Playwright. Slots occur at Constraints:13/35, Render:12/22, Functional:3/413, Polish:11/51 and Visual:11/53. app_context.md has the Application, Accounts and Key screens sections required by the contract. Reproducing test.sh:195-200's exact str.replace operation in memory removed every app_context slot from all five prompts and preserved exactly one criteria slot each; replacing that slot with the parsed criteria as a structural witness left no unresolved reserved placeholders and included every criterion id. Expanded context-only lengths were 6,660 / 5,793 / 60,226 / 9,807 / 8,204 characters respectively (Constraints/Render/Functional/Polish/Visual). This is source-level resolution, not a claim that RewardKit's serializer was run. test.sh:203-227 runs gates 1500, score.py, then scored 11100, score.py; each judge timeout (600/600/9000/900/900) is below its suite limit and 1500+11100=12600 is below task.toml's 13200 verifier timeout. tools/score.py:10 resolves the existing parent tests/scoring.toml. tests/Dockerfile installs pinned Playwright MCP and RewardKit, creates /usr/local/bin/chromium and copies the tests tree. scoring.toml, test.sh, score.py and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to their frozen canonical template counterparts.

Adversarial checks and alternatives: in-memory copies of the parsed structures rejected a Likert gate, zero criterion weight, duplicate criterion id, missing browser server and per-judge model override. A conforming scored profile with a positive unnormalized criterion weight 2.25 and existing anchored Likert type was accepted. These tests changed no frozen source. At the submission level, a conforming server-rendered shared library has an explicit accepted path in Constraints judge.toml:27 and the scored global gates; a static UI or same-context localStorage library cannot satisfy the two basic gates (Render:25 requires the freshly authored marker in both preview and console; Constraints:25-27 requires a new server write and independent clean-context retrieval). These are source-level counterexample inspections; no new browser app experiment was run. No concrete false-pass or false-fail witness attributable to this structural wiring was found.

Relevant raw evidence was inspected without reading other reviewers: golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json declares paid_provider=false, browser_driver="direct pinned Playwright" and oracle_score_claimed=false. Its restart and facts/S22.process_restart_durability/evidence/actual_restart contain one successful restart_app call, an advertised empty-object tool schema, isError=false, PID 16 -> 335 and 5.645670579979196 seconds. The before/after records preserve Primary id=3 revision=2 and Second id=4 revision=1. The restart_mcp.py SHA256 03c1426f00e451f4d86b7547761715328c63cdf299f5f812f46c9fa3b44979b5 matches the frozen tool. Read the executed launch_workflow.py:58-74: it extracts the canonical helper, substitutes paths and invokes the MCP directly, so it does not prove RewardKit's env substitution or a full configured judge run. Its hash and library_flow.cjs hash match RESULTS.json driver_sha256. Runtime/Oracle/target-model measurements remain separate and unmeasured by this point-24 review. CONFIRMED refers to the completed structural parser/substitution/handshake checks, not full evaluator completion.
